---
title: "Presentations"
---

I regularly present my research on **Long Covid, socialization, dispositions, and social-biological interactions**, as well as related work on health inequalities and illness trajectories. My presentations draw on both qualitative and quantitative approaches to social inquiry.

::: {.talks}
